t: This is London Pride, a sculpture of two nude women on a slate platform on Queen's Walk, on the South Bank. Frank Dobson made it for the Festival of Britain in 1951. His widow, Mary Dobson, gave it in 1987, and it was placed here. It became Grade II listed in January 2016. Dobson was a British sculptor, considered one of the best in Europe in his time, and a contemporary of Jacob Epstein and Henry Moore.
